info.name: Printlet API Integration v1 — Sequential E2E
info.description:
Run requests top-to-bottom. The collection discovers valid catalog IDs, ingests artwork, renders a preview, quotes fulfillment, creates prepaid and COD orders, verifies COD, exercises cancellation, reads events, and (for test keys) simulates fulfillment.

MULTIPLE PRINT AREAS: a configuration supports 1–10 distinct print areas, each with its own artwork. Create a quote containing the full configuration, then create the order from that quote. See docs/api-integration/MULTI_PRINT_AREA_STATUS.md for the two-area request example.

SAFE DEFAULT: use a prnt_test_ credential. Test orders stay inside the production-hosted sandbox and do not appear as fulfillment orders in the normal merchant Orders dashboard.

DASHBOARD E2E: use a prnt_live_ credential on Printlet staging and explicitly set run_live_dashboard_flow=true. Live credentials can charge the merchant wallet and create fulfillment work. A live COD order appears in the Orders dashboard immediately as On Hold; it is released and charged only after COD verification. Prepaid orders appear after Printlet payment is committed.

Documentation: https://stg-portal.printleteg.com/developers/api-integration

exec: throw new Error('Set api_key to a copied prnt_test_ or prnt_live_ credential before sending requests.');
